profile.headline: Software Engineer @ SoFi
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer passionate in building innovative, user focused solutions. My journey spans  organizations such as American Airlines, Paycom, LinkedIn, Twitter, and USAA.

I bring hands on experience across Java, Go, PHP, JavaScript, and Python, along with modern frameworks and platforms such as Spring Boot, Kafka, React, and Redux. My work has ranged from building backend services and automation tools for large scale infrastructure, to designing intuitive user interfaces that improve service management and operational workflows.

Beyond internships and professional roles, I’ve pursued independent projects, releasing a movie recommendation iOS app on the Apple App Store and designing an Android app that leverages Google Maps for interactive restaurant discovery.

My academic foundation includes a B.A. in Economics from UCLA and a B.S. in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Dallas, where I graduated summa cum laude.

I’m always excited to tackle new challenges, grow alongside brilliant teams, and create meaningful impact through technology. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and built a Spring Boot microservice in Java that consumed passenger flight events from Kafka, processed the data, and persisted it in Couchbase (NoSQL) to enable real-time tracking of passengers’ wheelchairs throughout their trip
Created RESTful APIs deployed on Azure that queried a PostgreSQL (SQL) database to retrieve and update AAdvantage loyalty program data, supporting scalable access for millions of customers
Modernized developer workflows by migrating from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, improving CI/CD reliability, reducing pipeline failures, and accelerating delivery
Mentored an engineering intern on development practices and code reviews, resulting in the successful delivery of two production projects and faster onboarding
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · GitHub · IntelliJ IDEA · MySQL · Databases · Teamwork · JavaScript · React · Redux · Dart · Flutter
